h1:
Koh Samui vs Koh Phangan
which to choose?
intro: Torn between Koh Samui and Koh Phangan? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: Choose Koh Samui for a fully developed island with an airport, luxury resorts and lots of dining. Choose Koh Phangan for a more laid-back, cheaper vibe, quiet pretty beaches in the north, or the Full Moon Party. The two are close — about a 30-minute boat ride apart.

blocks.text: Koh Samui vs Koh Phangan at a glance

items: Pick Koh Samui if you want convenience, direct flights, luxury resorts and lots of dining — great for families
Pick Koh Phangan if you want a laid-back, cheaper feel, quiet pretty beaches, or the Full Moon Party
Do both — about a 30-minute boat apart; many fly into Samui then ferry to Phangan

faq.q: Koh Samui or Koh Phangan — which is better?
faq.a: Samui is more convenient and developed, with an airport and luxury resorts — good for families and comfort seekers. Phangan is more laid-back and cheaper, with quiet pretty beaches and the Full Moon Party, suiting backpackers and chilled travelers.

faq.q: Do I have to go through Koh Samui to reach Koh Phangan?
faq.a: Not necessarily, but it is convenient. Phangan has no airport, so many fly into Samui and take a ~30-minute ferry, or take a ferry from Surat Thani (Donsak) straight to Phangan.

faq.q: Which island is better for a quiet trip?
faq.a: The north of Koh Phangan, such as Thong Nai Pan, is quiet with beautiful beaches, ideal for relaxing. On Samui, choose Maenam or Choeng Mon instead of Chaweng for a quieter stay.
